description: maxBy returns the item with the largest key, not the key itself
code:
bids = [{who: "ada", amount: 120}, {who: "bo", amount: 150}, {who: "cy", amount: 90}]
leader = bids.maxBy(bid -> bid.amount)
leader.who

description: A live declaration keeps the cheapest open offer as offers change
code:
class Offer(seller, price, open):
    this.seller = seller
    this.price = price
    this.open = open
best = Offer.filter(offer -> offer.open).minBy(offer -> offer.price)
Offer("ada", 40, true)
low = Offer("bo", 25, false)
Offer("cy", 30, true)
low.open = true
best.seller

description: On a tie maxBy and minBy keep the item that comes first
code:
scores = [{name: "ana", points: 9}, {name: "ben", points: 3}, {name: "cy", points: 9}, {name: "dan", points: 3}]
[scores.maxBy(score -> score.points).name, scores.minBy(score -> score.points).name]

description: Two strings compare as text, so minBy finds the alphabetically first name
code:
names = ["mia", "Ada", "zoe", "bo"]
first = names.minBy(name -> name)
last = names.maxBy(name -> name)
names.push("Abe")
[first, last]

description: Dates compare by time, so maxBy keeps the latest event live
code:
class Event(name, at):
    this.name = name
    this.at = at
latest = Event.maxBy(event -> event.at)
Event("deploy", new Date("2026-11-01"))
Event("review", new Date("2026-11-03"))
Event("standup", new Date("2026-11-02"))
latest.name

description: A class-level rule keeps the nearest charger of every robot
code:
class Charger(name, x):
    this.name = name
    this.x = x
class Robot(name, x):
    this.name = name
    this.x = x
$Robot.dock = Charger.minBy(charger -> Math.abs(charger.x - $Robot.x))
Charger("west", 0)
Charger("east", 10)
rex = Robot("rex", 7)
ivy = Robot("ivy", 2)
rex.x = 3
[rex.dock.name, ivy.dock.name]

description: A missing key makes the extreme item unknown until the key is set
code:
class Bid(amount): this.amount = amount
ada = Bid(120)
bo = Bid(90)
leader = Bid.maxBy(bid -> bid.amount)
delete bo.amount
unknown := leader
bo.amount = 200
[unknown, leader == bo]
